metric_protocol: CER/WER micro-averaged, NFC + whitespace collapse + bidi-control removal; case, accents and digit scripts preserved. Generator reference text, not manual photo transcription. Null means no denominator. End-to-end accuracy requires accepted correct ID. Name metric is exact visible alias recall, not inferred brand transcription accuracy.
latency_protocol: Warm in-process service, decode+all OCR passes+matching; excludes HTTP/upload/startup. p95 inclusive quantile. Groups may be small and share photo families.
engine:
tesseract 5.5.1
 leptonica-1.85.0
  libjpeg 6b (libjpeg-turbo 1.5.3) : libpng 1.6.34 : libtiff 4.0.9 : zlib 1.2.11 : libwebp 1.0.0

thresholds.calibration: Synthetic development-only grid selection: maximize correct accepts subject to zero observed false accepts; conservative tie break. No population probability calibration.
